newsitem.title: USA: Biopharmaceutics to develop cancer drug.
newsitem.headline: Biopharmaceutics to develop cancer drug.

text.p: Biopharmaceutics Inc said on Tuesday it has entered into a tentative deal with Advanced Biological Systems Inc for a joint venture for development of Mitolactol, a cancer drug.
All funding for the joint venture will be provided by Advanced Biological, Biopharmaceutics said.
Biopharmaceutics will receive monetary and equity considerations for entering into the joint venture and will be responsible for handling the management of the project, the company said.
The companies expect to enter into a final Agreement no later than Sept. 30, 1996.
Mitolactol currently holds Orphan Drug Status for the indications of brain and cervical cancer, the company said.
